paid_execution: disabled; completed v1 campaign authorization does not enable this design

motivation.observed_v1: 54 consumed development episodes; C invoked zero checks and obtained nonempty rows in zero episodes. Cannot estimate validation efficacy. Input impact policy reversed the wrong relation.
motivation.objective: Separate query-interface usability from subsequent optional validator use while preserving LLM responsibility for interpretation, filters, evidence and final decisions.

preserve: published v1 runtime snapshots and references
all v1 calls, failures, budgets and scores
immutable_history.new_version_rule: Future v2 exporter creates a new directory and protocol ID, refuses overwrites, records old/new public policy hashes and exact policy diff. No historical answer or score replacement; any re-use is consumed development.

public_policy_correction.old: Follow current BOM membership transitively from part to containing products, reversing part_of edges.
public_policy_correction.new: Starting at a part, follow part_of from subject to object and contains from object to subject to reach containing assemblies or products. Apply the same published activity/date/inclusion/scope policies. Return only the products requested in the question.
public_policy_correction.basis: Declared public relation meanings and source subject/object layout; not a repair chosen from expected answers.
public_policy_correction.scope: Only the relation-direction clause changes. Current/exported v1 files remain unchanged. Confirm wording against source records independently before v2 generation.
public_policy_correction.negative_control: Do not traverse contains from subject to object when seeking containing products; direction choice and requested endpoints remain observable.

runtime_tool_contract.name: lookup_records

items.field: published property name from global allowlist
items.value: JSON scalar string, number or boolean; no objects, raw SPARQL or IRIs

semantics: Conjunctive equality over literal properties on the same record. kind selects physical record type, not inferred workflow.
Return whole matching records with actual ID, fields and scalar types; missing fields stay absent. No caller-selected projection initially.
An empty filters array returns records of that kind up to the cap; model chooses whether broad inspection is warranted.
Do not infer active status, role, date, unit conversion, graph direction, source completeness or decision policy. Do not auto-correct valid but inappropriate filters.
Dates remain strings in this adapter; model may retrieve records then assess time policy itself. No hidden current-date default.
Explicitly choose behavior for duplicate filters: conjunction; conflicting values may produce zero rows, not automatic repair.
Unknown kinds/fields/operators or invalid types yield request-schema error only. Valid wrong roles/IDs must execute normally and preserve empty/wrong results.
compiler: Use a fixed, typed read-only SELECT pattern; serialize scalar literals through RDF library primitives, never interpolate raw model fragments.
Resolve field IRIs exclusively from published allowlist; preserve original scalar datatypes. No eval, template selection by question, URL/file path or SERVICE access.
Return matching record subject IDs from bounded SELECT; retrieve outgoing triples only for those records within the same bounded worker.
Reuse existing local worker resource restrictions and independently test that full record materialization also stays within deadline/memory/output caps.
runtime_tool_contract.truncation: Fetch one extra matching record to detect cap where feasible; any output-byte/cell cap must also signal truncation. A non-truncated subset does not establish question coverage.
runtime_tool_contract.tool_choice: LLM decides kind, filters, further calls, optional checking and final answer; no scorer task ID or reference-driven router.

comparison.first_stage: Offline adapter tests only. No new model study has been authorized or executed by this heartbeat.
comparison.future_factorial: Cross query interface (free SPARQL vs lookup_records) with existing A/B/C information/check availability on v2 inputs. Predeclare assignment count, order, budgets and stop rules before any future paid execution.
comparison.matching: All arms share corrected public policies, physical schema, source bytes, accessible fields, resource caps and neutral serialization examples. B/C retain identical extra ontology information; only C has optional validation.
comparison.causal_limit: Structured lookup constrains query search space, returns full records and removes raw syntax generation; this is an interface/scaffolding package, not a pure syntax ablation. Free SPARQL has greater expressivity. Restrict claims accordingly and report generated-query/algebra capabilities.
comparison.graph_limit: Adapter has no path traversal, join, aggregate or OWL inference. Multi-record reasoning remains LLM work. This is not a graph advantage benchmark.
comparison.checks: Optional check availability and realized use are distinct. Zero calls is an orchestration outcome, not a null effect of SHACL. A forced-check diagnostic, if later used, must be a separately named condition.
comparison.query_check_bridge: Before C integration, specify how model-declared interpretation and generated query are passed to existing contract checker. Successful compilation checks syntax only; it must not certify intended-question semantics.
comparison.evidence_check_bridge: Only retrieved IDs may enter existing selected-record SHACL tool. Full record retrieval changes evidence visibility, so quantify missing fields and compare information received.

offline_acceptance: Public policy direction examples verified independently from scorer references; v1 source and published input hashes unchanged.
Exact structural argument validation; booleans distinct from integers; invalid limit, nonfinite number, unknown field and injection-like string tests.
Known record examples across all seven physical kinds; typed literal round trips and missing-property behavior.
Valid wrong role and wrong subject queries return their actual rows/empty results without repair or invented policy decisions.
Generated-query parity against independently constructed direct graph filtering on authored software fixtures; not model accuracy.
Deadline, memory, record and output limits cover selection plus outgoing-record materialization; truncation and worker termination retained.
Runtime has no scorer/reference paths or task labels; freeze/source/policy hashes recorded and unexpected fields rejected.
Scripted tool traces explicitly labelled software fixtures; no claimed new LLM results or check efficacy.
analysis_requirements: Assigned episodes and unfinished outcomes retained.
Interpretation, syntax/argument errors, successful retrieval, source absence, retrieval omission, applicable evidence, check invocation, unsupported checks and final answer assessed separately.
Status agreement without necessary evidence remains separate from grounded success. Added unsupported caveats are audited separately from merely required caveat presence.
Count all model-requested tools, processed tools, guard rejections and actually executed worker operations separately; v1 overflow sentinel is not an executed eleventh tool.
Measure cost and model/tool turns without claiming equal realized effort; same policy facts should be accessible before interpretations.
next_step: Implement versioned policy exporter plus generic lookup adapter and software fixtures under a new native review job; keep paid calls stopped. No edits to v1 runner or raw artifacts in this design tick.
